jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. jobs.title: Langfuse - Senior Software Engineer, SDK
jobs.description: Why SDK Engineering at Langfuse Your work will have an outsized impact. Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month. When you ship a new integration or improve SDK performance, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. The SDK is often the very first thing a developer touches when they try Langfuse, so your work directly shapes their first impression. You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM-applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers in the world and that leverage Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible SDK experience and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. You will grow at Langfuse by Owning our SDKs . We maintain SDKs in Python and TypeScript both built on OpenTelemetry. You'll be responsible for their reliability, performance, and developer experience. These SDKs run inside our users' production systems, which means they must never fail, must have minimal impact on CPU and memory, and must work flawlessly across every environment — from serverless functions to long-running agent loops. You'll think deeply about the exposed interfaces, error handling, batching, async flushing, and graceful degradation. Designing APIs that developers love . How are functions named, how are parameters structured, how are breaking changes communicated, how does the documentation read? Developer experience is a core differentiator for Langfuse and you'll own every detail of it. When we shipped the Python SDK v3 and TypeScript SDK v4 , both were full rewrites on OpenTelemetry — that's the kind of thoughtful, high-impact SDK work you'll lead. Apart from tracing, we also support core workflows of engineers building with LLMs with our SDKs, see our Experiment Runner SDK for example. Integrating with every major AI framework : Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You'll maintain these integrations, ensure new Langfuse features are supported across all of them, and add new integrations as the ecosystem evolves. When a new framework gains traction, you'll be among the first to instrument it. Maintaining our OpenTelemetry endpoint : some users send traces directly to our OTLP endpoint instead of using our SDKs. You'll ensure this path is robust, well-documented, and supports the full range of Langfuse features. This also extends our language support to Java, Go, and any language with an OpenTelemetry SDK. You can work with the OpenTelemetry community to steer the GenAI conventions. Writing public documentation : you'll own the SDK docs, integration guides, and migration paths. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new SDK version or integration, the docs ship with it. What we're looking for Strong engineer who gets excited about developer experience, API design, and writing code that runs reliably in other people's production systems Experience building or maintaining SDKs, client libraries, or developer tools — ideally in Python and/or TypeScript Deep understanding of performance: you know how to profile, benchmark, and minimize CPU/memory overhead in hot paths Someone who can manage projects themselves — you know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it Thoughtful about versioning, backwards compatibility, and migration paths Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their integration challenges Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters CS or quantitative degree preferred Bonus points: Experie

Look for practical ways to improve processes, documentation and the use of finance systems and data. Apply what you learn through ACCA study to real finance work, building technical, analytical and communication skills over time. Eligibility Requirements This role is offered as a government-funded Level 7 ACCA apprenticeship. Appointment is conditional on the successful candidate meeting the government’s apprenticeship funding and eligibility requirements at the start of training, as confirmed by our approved training provider. Their goal is to build backend scientific data infrastructure to meet the demands of AI systems that can truly accelerate and automate the discovery layer of chemistry. Both founders hold PhDs in Chemistry from the University of Oxford, and the venture has already secured pre-seed funding. They are now building out their founding team. The Role As a Computational Chemist, you will play a central role in shaping the scientific foundations of the venture's technology, helping develop the computational methods and workflows that underpin its end-to-end chemical reaction simulation platform. You’ll work closely with researchers and engineers to integrate state-of-the-art computational chemistry methods with machine learning approaches, driving progress towards the venture's strategic and scientific objectives. You’ll take ownership of developing, validating and optimising the computational chemistry components of the platform, with a particular focus on reaction mechanisms, reaction kinetics, molecular dynamics and the modelling of complex chemical environments. You will design, implement and refine scalable scientific workflows for generating, processing and analysing chemical reaction data, improving the accuracy, reliability and computational efficiency of simulations. You'll be responsible for developing protocols for estimating solvation and entropy factors in chemical reaction steps. This involves keeping up to date with published literature for ideas and inspiration. Generative models: The venture is expanding its foundational data corpus beyond combinatorial workflows. You'll help design, validate and benchmark the generative model architectures that accomplish this. Chemical reaction simulation: The team is building out an end-to-end chemical reaction simulation platform. You'll be involved in designing the architecture and assembling the platform, as well as developing benchmarks and validation protocols against computational and experimental methods. World models and agents: The venture will be developing an agent + world model stack that operates on the simulation platform. You'll be responsible for formulating the action space in which the world model is trained and the agent explores new chemical reaction space. jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
jobs.description: At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job. Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. What You'll Work On You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include: Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist. What Success Looks Like Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable. Who We're Looking For We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious. Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning No active backlogs Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance b

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand. We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution. Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals. Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics. Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance. What You'll Need to Thrive Essential Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation. Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions. Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority. Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy. Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact. Nice to Have Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments. Background working across international or multi-market structures. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develo

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: About Swap Swap is the infrastructure behind modern agentic commerce. The only AI-native platform connecting backend operations with a forward-thinking storefront experience. Built for brands that want to sell anything - anywhere, Swap centralises global operations, powers intelligent workflows, and unlocks margin-protecting decisions with real-time data and capability. Our products span cross-border, tax, returns, demand planning, and our next-generation agentic storefront, giving merchants full transparency and the ability to act with confidence. At Swap, we’re building a culture that values clarity, creativity, and shared ownership as we redefine how global commerce works. About the role Our agentic storefront is an AI shopping experience that helps shoppers discover, decide, and buy through natural conversation. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll be a technical leader on the team building it. You’ll set direction for several engineering teams, take on the hardest cross-cutting problems, and stay hands-on in the code that matters most. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Data, and engineering leadership to turn ambitious goals into practical plans, and you’ll help the engineers around you do their best work. Responsibilities Lead large initiatives that run for several quarters and involve multiple teams, from first scoping through to production. Write exemplar code in critical paths, setting the implementation bar for the wider group. Review important designs from other teams, helping engineers balance quality, speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability. Define and uphold operational standards for the group: monitoring, availability, scalability, security, release safety, and cost awareness. Help lead serious incidents and follow through on the right fixes. Lead tool evaluations and architecture migrations, making build-vs-buy trade-offs explicit. Use AI well beyond the basics, and push back on AI-generated complexity so code health holds as we speed up. Own the business result of your work. Define success metrics, monitor after launch, and challenge constructively when something won’t move the needle for merchants. Mentor Senior Engineers and below, and lead or join senior-level interviews. Write and improve the documentation others rely on, such as architecture direction, decision records, and runbooks. Requirements Significant experience (typically 8+ years) building and shipping production software, with a record of leading complex initiatives that cross team lines. Deep expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js, including architecting REST and/or GraphQL APIs and distributed systems. Comfort outside your home language and stack. We expect Staff engineers to be T-shaped. Strong relational database, data modelling, and SQL skills, plus familiarity with NoSQL. Experience designing for reliability and scale in the cloud, with solid CI/CD, observability, and incident-response practices. Hands-on experience with LLMs or agentic systems, or a track record of picking up new technology fast and applying it sensibly. Daily use of AI coding tools, with a sense for when to trust them and when not to. Experience in eCommerce systems and platforms is preferred. Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain trade-offs in business terms to any audience. A team player with a bias for ownership: you bring a solution along with the problem, and work isn’t done until it’s live and stable. What we offer 💰 Competitive base salary: Pay that reflects your experience and the impact you’ll have, reviewed regularly as you grow with us. 📈 Stock options: Own a piece of what we’re building. As a high-growth scale-up, you’ll share in the upside as the company grows. 🏖️ Generous PTO: Competitive annual leave, with public holidays on top, plus your birthday off so you can celebrate properly. 🏥 Private healthcare: Comprehensive private medical cover, so you can get the care you need quickly. 🏦 Pension contributions: Co

jobs.title: Quality Systems Lead
jobs.description: About us Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator. The role We're hiring a Quality Systems Lead to own how Encord measures the quality of the human data we deliver to frontier AI labs, physical AI companies and enterprise AI teams — the standard itself, the systems that evaluate against it, and the audit function that produces the ground truth behind both. Data quality is what our customers buy. As we scale across data types — image and video, document, medical, LLM evaluation, robot teleoperation, egocentric capture — quality coverage cannot scale linearly with headcount. So this role has two halves that make each other work. You will build automated evaluation: model-assisted and LLM-based screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output. And you will build and run a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists in India, whose judgements become the labelled ground truth that trains and calibrates that automated layer. As coverage automates, the audit team moves up to the cases models can't judge and to generating gold sets for each new data type we take on. It is an unusual combination — engineering and consistent QC operations in one person — and it is the combination the job needs. You will also have an advantage your counterparts elsewhere in the industry don't: Encord owns the platform this work runs on, so the measurement you build can become native capability in the product rather than internal tooling. What you'll do Build automated dataset quality evaluation and root-cause detection — model-assisted and LLM-as-judge screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output Hire, train, calibrate and manage a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists based in our India operation, held to inter-rater agreement and catch rate rather than volume audited Turn audit output into labelled ground truth that trains and validates the automated layer, and manage the ratio of automated to manual coverage deliberately over time Own the quality standard for every data type we deliver — written rubrics with worked edge cases, golden sets, and acceptance criteria agreed with the customer, alongside the Special Projects lead, before the first batch ships Build scoring systems that rank annotator and reviewer performance and feed routing, staffing and offboarding decisions Set the pass thresholds that certification gates on, so nobody works a project queue without having demonstrated they meet the standard Report quality KPIs to leadership, and into the reporting our Special Projects leads take to customers: accuracy against client spec, inter-annotator agreement, rework rate, cost of rework, and coverage Work with Project Management on remediation — you produce the measurement and the diagnosis, production owns fixing the project, and the standard stays independent of the people being measured Own the unit economics of quality: cost per audited unit, and the coverage you buy per pound spent Partner with Product and Engineering to bring quality measurement into Encord platform as native capability Who we're looking for You build and you operate. You'll write the evaluation pipeline, and you'll also run the weekly calibration session with ten auditors in another country Your instinct on a coverage problem is to automate it — you reach for a model, a heuristic or a better sampling design before you reach for more auditors Statistically literate in a practical way: sampling design, agreement statistics, and the judgement to spot a metric being opti

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: About us Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator. The role We're hiring Technical Program Managers in London to run Encord's highest-stakes human data projects end to end — the work for frontier AI labs and physical AI companies, in specialist domains such as medical imaging and robotics, and the data types we are running for the first time. These are the projects where the technical complexity is highest and where a mistake is expensive. You will work at the point where machine learning requirements become annotation work: translating what a research team actually needs into workflows, standards and instructions that a specialist workforce can execute at volume, then holding the result to a measurable standard. This is the load-bearing role in the business, and it is a hands-on one. You will know your projects' annotation standards better than anyone at the company, teach them to the annotators producing the work, decide who works on what, judge who is performing and who should come off, resolve the edge cases nobody anticipated, and answer for the delivery timeline. You will run several projects at once, and you will own how they are run. What you'll do Own delivery of your projects end to end — throughput, quality and timeline Translate complex machine learning requirements into clear annotation workflows, and design the process that produces the data the model actually needs Become the deepest expert at Encord on your project's annotation standards, and the person who resolves ambiguity and edge cases as they surface Maintain quality through process refinement, auditing and structured feedback loops, rather than through inspection at the end Train annotators onto the project and keep them improving — building the material yourself until our Learning & Development Specialist is in place Coach your annotation teams: give them the context behind the task, not only the rules, and develop their skills as the work gets harder Measure annotator performance and make the calls it implies: who continues, who needs retraining, who comes off the project Allocate tasks and manage the queue so that throughput and quality targets are met together rather than traded against each other Instrument the project at launch with the Quality Systems Lead — acceptance criteria, sampling plan, reviewer ratio — so it is measurable before the first batch ships Produce the delivery reporting for customers, and surface risk early enough that something can still be done about it Partner with Product and Engineering on process and tooling improvements, and feed recurring problems back into the playbooks, into training and into the platform Who we're looking for You go deep on the detail. Your instinct is to read the whole specification and annotate fifty items yourself before you assign anyone else Execution-oriented: you are measured by what shipped, not by what was planned, and you would rather fix a workflow than document one Analytically rigorous. You work in numbers — throughput, quality rate, utilisation — and you notice when one is being bought at the expense of another Technically fluent enough to work with ML teams on what they need and why, and to pull your own data rather than wait for it You make people calls on evidence rather than on impression, and you can have the difficult version of that conversation Organised under real load: several projects, several time zones, and requirements that move A clear writer and a strong cross-functional communicator. jobs.description: ABOUT BEAMERY With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies. We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people. So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all. What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: Building agentic AI with advanced orchestration (multi-agent workflows, tool use, evaluation loops) that turns complex talent data into decisions. Training and fine-tuning our own models on unique data about jobs, skills and tasks, and benchmarking them against the best in our market. Joining an award-winning AI team (ACM RecSys Challenge 2026) that turns new ideas into innovative solutions with scientific rigour. Sharing our work and learning from industry peers through challenges, conferences and publications. But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work. About the Team The Data Science team builds the AI models behind Beamery's Data Foundry, the common data and AI layer powering all Beamery products, and works hand in hand with the product teams to empower their features with AI (such as Talent Match and recommendations). At the heart of our work is the Beamery taxonomy, the language of work (skills, role titles and tasks) that every Beamery product speaks, built on more than a decade of research and kept current by the Taxonomist, our agentic system, so it reflects the real pulse of the job market. We combine LLMs, Transformers and embedding models with classic machine learning, always choosing the best balance between quality, latency and cost. We see ourselves as pioneers in AI for HR Tech: in 2026 the team finished 1st in the industry track and 2nd overall out of 40 teams at the ACM RecSys Challenge. You will be responsible for the full cycle of your work, from defining how quality is measured and designing the models to running robust scientific experiments, tracking technical and business metrics, and writing and reviewing code. You will also advise the product teams on how to implement AI features with an evaluation-first mindset, and keep pushing the boundaries of Beamery's AI. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (EMEA)
jobs.description: About Us: Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI. The Role: As a Member of Technical Staff on the EMEA field team, you build on top of one of the largest inference platforms in the world. The work spans the stack: capabilities on top of inference and serving, tooling around fine-tuning and post-training of LLMs, and the product our region’s customers need that the core platform team will not take on. You are first and foremost an excellent software engineer; that is what we are testing for. You prefer building product to being customer-facing, and that is exactly right for this role, though you are welcome to join customer work when it interests you. Treat this as a flexible role: a bucket for exceptional builders at different levels of experience rather than a fixed job spec. There is no specific seniority requirement; anywhere from 3 to 10 years of experience can fit. What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background. Key Responsibilities: Build: Design and ship product capabilities end to end, from ambiguous need to running in production. Build on Inference: Create capabilities on top of the serving stack: routing, model controls, observability, and whatever a deployment turns out to need. Build on Training: Ship tooling around fine-tuning and post-training of LLMs, from data pipelines to evaluation, working alongside our applied ML engineers. Own Regional Capability: Turn EMEA-specific requirements into product, working with core platform where the line is unclear. Engineering Quality: Set the engineering bar for the regional team; your code is the reference. Agentic Development: Use coding agents and AI tooling as a core part of how you build, with judgment about when to trust the output. Optional Customer Work: Join deployments or customer conversations when useful or interesting; never required. Minimum Qualifications: First principles and critical thinking: the ability to break down novel problems and reason to a solution without a reference implementation. This is the primary interview signal and can outweigh other qualifications. jobs.title: Associate Team Lead - Customer Support (T2)
jobs.description: Résumé Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables. Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable dans leur quotidien. L’équipe Support Niveau 2 intervient sur les demandes les plus complexes ou nécessitant une expertise métier et produit approfondie, en lien avec les équipes Support Niveau 1, Support Technique, Produit et Tech. Ce rôle est un poste de management de proximité : tu seras le relais opérationnel du Team Lead Support N2 et accompagneras une équipe de 6 à 12 agents au quotidien pour leur permettre de répondre aux utilisateurs avec efficacité, qualité et empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité, à l’amélioration continue du support et à des projets transverses. Notre culture Au sein du Support, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience . Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations pour donner du feedback constructif. Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité de l’équipe, comme le temps de première réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume de tickets traités. Remonter les irritants utilisateurs aux équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops. Contribuer à améliorer les process, la documentation et les outils internes. Donner des feedbacks clairs, réguliers et transparents, réaliser des écoutes et analyses de conversations, suivre les bilans et plans d’accompagnement individuels, proposer des coachings et identifier les besoins de formation. Suivre les indicateurs de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, notamment le temps de première réponse, la satisfaction client, le temps de résolution, le volume traité, la prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et le suivi des tickets en cours. Participer aux rituels de pilotage et à la gestion des files de demandes communes, notamment lors des rotations de permanence, en identifiant les alertes et en remontant les besoins de renfort ou d’arbitrage. Être force de proposition pour optimiser les process, les outils, la documentation et les modes de fonctionnement du Support. Collaborer avec les équipes support de niveau 1, l’équipe technique, les équipes opérationnelles ainsi que les équipes produit et tech, faire remonter les irritants utilisateurs et contribuer aux projets transverses. Partager les bonnes pratiques avec les autres Associate Team Leads et contribuer à maintenir une communication fluide au sein du Support. jobs.title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Bordeaux & Gironde)
jobs.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent. Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 3 premiers mois : - Tu te formes sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe. - Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements. - Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements. - Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes. 4 à 6 mois : - Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs. - Tu commences

jobs.title: DIGITAL & B2B MARKETING MANAGER H/F - CDI
jobs.description: Chez Mistertemp’ Group, nous allions innovation digitale et proximité locale pour révolutionner le monde du recrutement (intérim, CDD, CDI). Présents en France, en Italie, en Espagne et au Canada, nous sommes fiers de figurer parmi les 12 startups HR Tech les plus innovantes en France et d’être lauréats des prestigieux French Tech 120 et Next 40. Grâce à notre plateforme technologique de pointe et à notre réseau de 250 agences, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen du recrutement. Pour relever ce défi, nous recherchons des talents créatifs, curieux et passionnés, prêts à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en constante transformation. Si ces valeurs vous inspirent et résonnent avec vos aspirations professionnelles, rejoignez l’aventure ! Développer une culture commerciale tournée vers les résultats, l'autonomie et l'amélioration continue. Garantir la fiabilité du CRM et la qualité du suivi commercial. Construire des prévisions commerciales fiables pour anticiper les besoins de production et les volumes de vente. Veiller à la rentabilité des accords et à la pérennité des relations commerciales. Présenter régulièrement à la Direction les résultats, les perspectives et les actions prioritaires. 4. Coordonner les lancements, promotions et engagements clients avec les équipes marketing, ADV, logistique, R&D et production. Anticiper les besoins des clients et assurer la bonne exécution des engagements commerciaux. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques et contribuer à la structuration de notre développement. jobs.title: Product Manager IA - Paris
jobs.description: 💡 Envie de construire des produits IA qui vont au-delà du POC ? L'intelligence artificielle transforme les usages, mais le véritable défi reste de concevoir des solutions utiles, performantes et capables de passer à l'échelle. Chez Hubvisory , nous accompagnons de grandes organisations dans la conception et le développement de produits digitaux à forte valeur ajoutée. Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Product Manager spécialisé(e) en IA pour imaginer, structurer et déployer des solutions innovantes, en combinant vision produit, compréhension technologique et impact business. 🎯 Ton rôle au quotidien Tu interviendras sur des projets stratégiques, de l'identification des opportunités jusqu'au déploiement des solutions. Tes principaux challenges : Identifier les opportunités IA : comprendre les enjeux business et utilisateurs pour faire émerger des cas d'usage pertinents. Définir la stratégie produit : construire et prioriser une roadmap cohérente, en intégrant les possibilités offertes par les LLM, le RAG et les agents IA. Passer de l'expérimentation à l'industrialisation : évaluer la faisabilité, anticiper les contraintes et garantir la création de valeur. Faire le lien entre métier et technologie : collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Engineering, Data et MLOps pour orienter les décisions produit. Mesurer la performance : définir les bons indicateurs, suivre l'adoption et optimiser les solutions en continu. Embarquer les parties prenantes : porter une vision claire, faciliter les arbitrages et accompagner le changement. Tu auras l'occasion d'évoluer dans des environnements exigeants, auprès de références telles que LVMH, Sephora, TF1 ou l'Urssaf . 🔎 Le profil que nous recherchons Nous recherchons avant tout un(e) Product Manager capable de connecter les enjeux business aux possibilités concrètes de l'intelligence artificielle. Ce qui fera la différence : Tu disposes de 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en Product Management , avec une expérience concrète sur des produits IA ou fortement orientés data. Les concepts de LLM, RAG, IA générative et systèmes agentiques te sont familiers. Tu sais travailler avec des équipes techniques, comprendre les grands principes d'une architecture IA et participer aux arbitrages sans nécessairement coder. Tu maîtrises les fondamentaux du Product Management : discovery, priorisation, delivery, KPI et OKR. Tu sais prendre du recul, challenger les besoins et défendre tes convictions avec pragmatisme. Tu es à l'aise dans des environnements complexes, avec des interlocuteurs variés. Tu communiques avec aisance en français comme en anglais . Ton état d'esprit ? Curieux(se), analytique, autonome et toujours à l'affût des évolutions de l'écosystème IA. ✨ Ce que tu trouveras chez Hubvisory Rejoindre Hubvisory, c'est intégrer une communauté de passionnés du Product, où l'expertise se partage et où chacun peut continuer à progresser. Au programme : 🎓 Un onboarding de 2 semaines au sein de notre Campus pour approfondir tes compétences Product. 🧠 Une communauté d'experts avec des rendez-vous réguliers pour partager retours d'expérience, méthodes et nouvelles pratiques. 📈 Une évolution accompagnée , avec des revues salariales deux fois par an. 🎁 Des avantages complémentaires : intéressement et jours de congés supplémentaires. 🎉 Une vraie vie d'équipe : événements, séminaires, activités et moments de convivialité. 💎 Une culture fondée sur cinq piliers : bienveillance, ambition, expertise, apprentissage et méritocratie. 💰 Package 46 000 à 58 000 € brut annuel fixe , selon expérience, auxquels s'ajoutent une rémunération variable et un dispositif d'intéressement. 🤝 Comment se déroule le recrutement ? Un processus structuré pour apprendre à se connaître et se projeter ensemble : Premier échange RH avec Caroline : ton parcours, tes motivations et tes attentes. Mise en situation Product : un cas pratique de 90 minutes avec un manager produit. Rencontre avec le leadership : 90 minutes d'échange avec un VP ou cofondateur dan

jobs.title: Guest Service Officer H/F
jobs.description: CHAMP D'APPLICATION DU POSTE Le/La agent(e) du service client (Guest Service Officer), doit assurer un service de première ligne irréprochable en prenant en charge l’enregistrement des clients ainsi que la gestion des accès aux lounges avec précision, professionnalisme et efficacité. Le/La collaborateur-rice contribue activement au bon fonctionnement de l’espace en accompagnant les clients, en assurant les contrôles de zone, en gérant les flux et les files d’attente, tout en identifiant et en escaladant rapidement les problématiques liées au service ou à la maintenance. Il/elle participe également au développement du chiffre d’affaires en promouvant et en vendant les offres lounges, les campagnes ponctuelles, les partenariats ainsi que les adhésions au programme Smart Traveller. Enfin, il/elle veille au respect des standards opérationnels en appliquant rigoureusement les procédures internes (SOP), en garantissant l’exactitude des transactions, en optimisant l’utilisation des ressources et en assurant un haut niveau d’hygiène ainsi que la confidentialité des clients. RESPONSABILITÉS DU POSTE Gérer efficacement le processus d'enregistrement des invités, en garantissant l'exactitude des droits des invités, le respect des consignes d'admission et la transmission d'une première impression bienvenue. Accueillir, recevoir et remercier les invités à la réception avec professionnalisme, courtoisie et excellence du service. Assister les clients lors de leurs demandes. Adresser rapidement les demandes des clients, en faisant remonter les questions complexes ou les préoccupations de service au responsable du lounge, si nécessaire. Effectuer des contrôles de routine dans les espaces de détente — tels que les zones de salon, buffet, aires de repos, et signaler immédiatement les problèmes d'entretien ou de propreté. Promouvoir activement les services proposés pour soutenir les objectifs de génération de revenus. Encourager et inscrire les clients au programme Smart Traveller (ST) en expliquant les avantages et en veillant à une bonne compréhension des informations lors de l'inscription. Suivre les procédures d'objets perdus en documentant avec précision les objets, en assurant une manipulation sécurisée et en informant le superviseur. Répondre de manière professionnelle aux appels téléphoniques, aux e-mails et aux communications internes, en veillant à une assistance rapide et à des informations claires. Gérer les transactions de points de vente, les reçus, les bons et les paiements sans espèces avec précision et conformément aux directives financières et aux procédures opérationnelles standard. Aider aux efforts de contrôle des coûts en utilisant de manière responsable la papeterie, les formulaires et les matériaux opérationnels et en signalant les gaspillages inutiles. Maintenir la confidentialité des informations des clients en permanence. Soutenir la préparation opérationnelle en aidant à la gestion des files d'attente, à l'affluence des foules, aux procédures d'ouverture/fermeture. Collaborer avec le responsable de service/lounge pour maintenir un flux de service fluide et respecter les normes internes PPG. Participer à des réunions d'équipe, des sessions de formation et des audits qualité afin d'améliorer la prestation des services et les connaissances opérationnelles. Effectuer toutes les tâches supplémentaires assignées par le superviseur ou le responsable des opérations. Cette liste est non exhaustive EXIGENCES DU POSTE Une première expérience en hôtellerie, restauration Bonnes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication Bonne maîtrise de l’anglais et du français Une autre langue parlée serait un plus Capable de travailler de manière autonome comme en équipe Bonne gestion du stress Conditions particulières : Flexibilité horaire, incluant une disponibilité lors des périodes de forte activité, des jours fériés et des week-ends Lieu du poste : En présentiel Ce que nous vous offrons Rejoignez un groupe international en pleine croi

Dans un contexte de croissance de l'entreprise et d'exigences opérationnelles, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'harmonisation des pratiques, la structuration du pilotage des activités et l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes. Définir et harmoniser les méthodes de pilotage des activités opérationnelles sur l'ensemble des sites. Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques. Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires. Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service. Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients. Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires. Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations. Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires. jobs.description: À propos de FPP Industries FPP Industries poursuit son développement et souhaite aujourd’hui structurer davantage sa fonction Ressources Humaines. jobs.title: Post-doctorant.e en conception de catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels pour la conversion directe du CO2 en carburants liquides (H/F) – CDD 11 mois
jobs.description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue.   DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes. Ce projet, qui réunit deux laboratoires (RAPSODEE à Albi, et LCC à Toulouse), vise à produire des carburants alternatifs par hydrogénation directe du CO2 via une synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch à partir de CO2 (CO2-FTS). Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). Ce projet continue la recherche récente entre les deux laboratoires sur le même sujet, en développant des systèmes catalytiques multifonctionnels assurant la conversion, en une seule étape, dans un seul réacteur et à une seule condition de température et de pression, du CO2 et H2 en carburants liquides. Une attention particulière sera accordée à l’ingénierie de la composition, de la structure et de l’environnement des sites actifs, afin d’établir des relations structure-activité et de comprendre le rôle de chaque composant métallique dans les différentes étapes réactionnelles. Cette stratégie vise à dépasser les limitations des catalyseurs conventionnels en améliorant leur activité, sélectivité, stabilité et résistance à la désactivation. Le projet contribuera ainsi au développement d’une nouvelle génération de catalyseurs multifonctionnels pour la valorisation directe et durable du CO2 en carburants et produits chimiques à valeur ajoutée. jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
jobs.description: At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job. Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. What You'll Work On You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include: Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist. What Success Looks Like Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable. Who We're Looking For We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious. Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning No active backlogs Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance b

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Samen met de CEO en COO werk je aan de verdere strategische en financiële ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Als CFO vertaal je de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete groeikansen door schaalbare verdien- en prijsmodellen te ontwikkelen. Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen.   Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Daarbij weeg je beschikbare financieringsopties zorgvuldig af op impact, liquiditeit en rendement. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Met heldere go/no-go-momenten per fase zorg je ervoor dat de ontwikkeling en implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen niet sneller gaat dan wat de organisatie kan adopteren. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Tegelijkertijd borg je dat contracten allesomvattende afspraken en een evenwichtige risicoverdeling bevatten, evenals uitvoerbaar zijn in alle landen waar Voortman Steel Machinery actief is. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn.   Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Tevens bewaak je per land en internationale entiteit het rendement, de cashflow, het werkkapitaal en houd je zicht op financiële, juridische, fiscale, contractuele en compliance-risico’s. Ook de financiële besturing en beheersing van Voortman Steel Machinery valt onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent internationaal eindverantwoordelijk voor consolidatie, planning & control, reporting, accounting, treasury, audit, tax, vennootschapsbelasting en interne beheersing. Aansluitend zie je toe op het opstellen van correcte en transparante rapportages per internationale entiteit. jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. jobs.title: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
jobs.description: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis) Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you. Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland) About Intero Integrity Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data. The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement. We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact. The opportunity This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide. What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week. Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here. What you will do Hands-on software development •      You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data •      You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams •      You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform •      You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow •      You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure •      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software •      You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection) Mentorship & working with partners •      You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills •      You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing •      You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard •      You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy •      You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently •      You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm What you bring Technical expertise •    &

jobs.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Integrity Engineer Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it. Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe. About Intero Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities. Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity . Your team You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department. Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients. Why this role matters An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on. What your week looks like Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments. ·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it. ·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards. ·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities. ·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions. ·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data. ·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards. ·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early. Why this matters: At bunq, our mission is to Make Life Easy, for our users, our teams, and the world around us. Every team plays a unique role in making this mission a reality. The Product team does this by building and improving the products our users bank with, while keeping them safe and compliant. As Head of Product, you contribute by setting product direction and leading the product leaders who deliver it, helping us grow as the bank of The Free. Take ownership: As Head of Product, you’ll take charge of key responsibilities that directly impact bunq’s growth and our users’ seamless experience: Grow our users’ use of bunq’s products by leading product strategy and delivery for your area. Keep growth and safety moving together, so that fraud, compliance and quality are built into the products rather than bolted on. Build a strong, AI-first product organization by leading Product Owners and Team Leads, and redesigning how the function works around AI agents instead of adding headcount by default. Be bunq’s product voice with the management board, regulators, auditors and partners. You’ve led a technical product organization and can get hands-on when needed. Size of organization isn’t the bar. You have product leadership experience in a regulated financial services setting. You understand payments and fraud, and you have data analysis skills and engineering depth. You have experience working with regulators and across multiple markets. You’re skilled at stakeholder management at management-board level. jobs.title: Content & Community Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Rolle Wir sind HeyHoney, ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit einer treuen Community und einem klaren Produkt. Diese Community ist eines unserer wertvollsten Assets – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Geschwindigkeit, Flexibilität und viel kreativer Gestaltungsraum – verbunden mit der Möglichkeit und Erwartung, diesen aktiv zu nutzen. Während unser Head of Performance & Growth die Skalierung verantwortet, machst du unsere Marke jeden Tag erlebbar: Du entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle, unseren Content und unsere Community-Formate weiter – vom ersten Konzept bis zum fertigen Reel, vom Community-Kommentar bis zum Event. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Creator, UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und berichtest direkt an unsere Head of Performance & Growth. Dein Verantwortungsbereich Content & Social Media: Du betreust und entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle – insbesondere Instagram, TikTok und Pinterest – und hast Trends, Plattform-Logiken und neue Formate immer im Blick. Dabei kannst du sowohl neuen Content produzieren als auch vorhandenes Material kreativ weiterdenken und daraus neue, plattformgerechte Inhalte entwickeln. Für Produktionen arbeitest du bei Bedarf mit UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und steuerst diese eigenständig. Community Management: Du bist eine der Stimmen von HeyHoney. Du interagierst regelmäßig mit unserer Community, aktivierst sie und entwickelst Ideen, mit denen aus Kund echte Fans werden. Dabei entwickelst du Community-Formate, die Bindung und Retention stärken. Community Events: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen für Community Events und begleitest deren Umsetzung – von Planung und Partner-/Location-Auswahl bis zur Durchführung und Nachbereitung. Launch-Support: Für unsere Kollektions-Launches entwickelst du organische Content- und Community-Ideen und verzahnst sie eng mit unseren Paid-Aktivitäten. Analytics & Reporting: Du behältst relevante KPIs wie Reichweite, Engagement und Community-Wachstum im Blick, erkennst, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus konkrete Learnings und neue Content-Ideen ab. Was du mitbringst Du fühlst dich auf Social Media zu Hause und verstehst, warum Content funktioniert – oder eben nicht. Dabei ist uns dein Gespür für Content, Community und relevante KPIs wichtiger als eine bestimmte Anzahl an Berufsjahren. Idealerweise bringst du mindestens ein Jahr praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Social Media, Content oder Community mit – zum Beispiel aus einer Festanstellung, Werkstudentätigkeit, einem Praktikum, Freelance-Projekten oder eigenen Social-Media-Projekten.
