jobs.description: UK | Full-Time The Mission: Source.dev Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework , Security , and the Android Runtime (ART) . Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation. Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS. The Core Product: SourceFS SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes. 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed. 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine. True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match. The Cultural Anchor: Own It We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership : "We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.” The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev . In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible. What You’ll Work On System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks. Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling. Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions. Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments. Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations. Ideal Candidate Profile: The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for. Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling. Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality - you see a friction point in the developer journey and you don’t stop until it’s gone. Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions. Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant coder, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate - someone who leads with kindness Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork. Strong stakeholder management is key to this role.   The demands on the Finance team are high as Zopa grows at pace, so you’ll need to build effective and influential relationships within Finance and the wider business. Our team are self-starting problem solvers who are agile and thrive on bringing past experiences and networks to a diverse range of challenges. You’ll be part of an impressive Zopa team, who are super collaborative and happy to roll their sleeves up and get involved in whatever needs doing to achieve their goals.   A day in the life Carry out technical accounting assessments for new transactions, products, significant contracts and other business initiatives, and draft clear accounting papers and memos.   Play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s ownership of the annual report and accounts, drafting parts of the report and coordinating other sections written by teams across Finance and the wider business, and helping to bring them together into the final report.   Manage stakeholders effectively and work well with other Zopa teams, including Product, Legal, Treasury and Risk, building strong, influential relationships and giving clear, practical technical accounting advice.   Support the development, implementation and upkeep of accounting policies and the accounting manual and give practical guidance on how policies should be applied across the business.   Help put new accounting treatments into practice: make sure finance systems and processes are set up to support new activities, embed them into business-as-usual (BAU) processes and hand them over to the BAU teams.   Support the technical accounting for balance sheet activity, including SPPI testing and hedge accounting assessments and documentation under IAS 39 and IFRS 9.   Support the timely and accurate delivery of month-end reporting where needed.   Work directly with the external auditors on accounting policy and technical accounting matters, answering queries and providing evidence and papers.   Carry out horizon scanning of new and proposed legislation, regulation and accounting standards that affect financial and corporate reporting, prepare impact assessments, and highlight high-impact or high-risk changes.   Help shape and deliver our work to automate the production of the annual report, an area where this role will be fundamental.   Look for ways to use AI and automation to improve technical accounting, policy and reporting processes, and put them into practice.

jobs.description: Who we are: We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay. We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers. Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us? About the role. We’re looking for a UX copywriter to join our copy team and help bring the Zilch brand to life across every digital customer touchpoint. Your primary focus will be partnering with Product Design to create clear and intuitive experiences across our app and website. Working closely with product designers, product managers and engineers, you'll contribute to creating customer journeys from discovery through to launch. You'll also collaborate with teams across the business, including Marketing, Customer Support and Operations, providing specialist copy support wherever it's needed – from SEO content and help articles to customer communications and product launches. This isn't just about writing functional copy. It's about creating experiences customers understand, trust and enjoy. You'll know when to keep things simple, when to inject personality and how to bring the Zilch tone of voice to life in even the smallest moments. We're looking for a creative and tactical thinker who understands that great UX copy does more than guide users from A to B. It solves problems, removes friction and creates experiences that feel simple, human and unmistakably Zilch. Day to day responsibilities. Partner with Product Design to create clear, engaging copy across the app and website, from new features to end-to-end customer journeys. Collaborate with product managers, designers and engineers throughout the product development process, from discovery through to launch. Write and optimise customer-facing content across digital touchpoints, including help articles, FAQs, SEO content and operational communications. Balance customer needs, business goals and regulatory requirements to create content that's clear, helpful and compliant. Use customer insight, data and testing to improve the content and customer journeys. Champion accessibility, consistency and best practice in UX writing and content design. Support wider business priorities with copy for product launches, campaigns and new initiatives when needed. What we’re looking for... You're a brilliant writer with experience creating content for digital products. Whether you've called yourself a UX Writer, Content Designer or Copywriter, you know how to use words to solve problems. You can switch effectively between product thinking and brand thinking. One minute you're refining onboarding copy, the next you're shaping a product launch or crafting a headline that makes someone smile. You know that the best digital experiences don't happen by accident. You're curious, ask the right questions and enjoy getting to the root of a problem before putting pen to paper. You care about craft. Every word has a purpose, every interaction has intent and you're never afraid to rewrite something until it feels just right. You understand our tone of voice and apply it consistently across customer communications, recognising how a brand comes to life through product. You know how to create experiences that feel consistent, human and unmistakably Zilch. You're a natural collaborator who enjoys bouncing ideas around with designers, product managers, marketers and developers. You know the best work happens when different disciplines come together. You're comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve, and you enjoy the variety that comes with it. Experience with Figma is important. jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description: We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure. At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform. Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage , and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox , and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026 . About the role As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built. We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it. What you’ll be doing Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, You will own a book of customers across EMEA, from crypto-native exchanges and payment providers through to the financial institutions and fintechs now launching digital asset products. Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them. jobs.description: About Agicap Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France. Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire. Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024. Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde. Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse ! Tu as le recul pour maintenir des systèmes en prod ET l'énergie pour aller construire la couche sémantique qui va connecter nos données à l'IA ? Chez Agicap , la Data Platform répond aux besoins analytics (reporting, IA) et de synchronisation de données au service de toute l'entreprise. Elle s'appuie sur Google Cloud Platform (notamment BigQuery et Composer), Airbyte , dbt et Looker pour maintenir et diffuser des données à jour, consolidées et fiables. 🔥 Le chantier qui change tout : l'ouverture de l'accès à la donnée d'entreprise par l'IA via notre serveur MCP Analytics . On a déjà posé les premières briques avec les Explores Looker gouvernés par les DA — la suite logique, c'est l'extension à BigQuery couplée à une couche sémantique . Et c'est là que tu entres en jeu. 👥L'équipe que tu rejoins Tu intègres une équipe de 3 Data Engineers qui collabore au quotidien avec 4 Data Analysts et Pauline (Head of Data) . Tu seras en lien direct avec Kévin (Team Lead Data Engineering) et Pauline au quotidien. L'équipe Data est rattachée au département Revenue & Operations . L'équipe en 3 mots : soudée, pragmatique, exigeante techniquement. On porte beaucoup de sujets stratégiques en parallèle — c'est pour ça qu'on cherche un·e senior qui pourra prendre vite ses marques et apporter du poids sur les décisions d'architecture. 💪 Tes missions Tu alternes entre run exigeant et chantiers structurants : Maintenir et fiabiliser la plateforme : Composer (Airflow), Airbyte self-hosted sur GKE, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform. Une part de ton temps va au run (gestion des incidents, support DA), réparti au sein de l'équipe DE. Tu conçois et enrichis tests, monitoring et alerting — technique et fonctionnel. Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery. Alimenter les outils métier : reverse-ETL et synchronisations entre outils (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom…) ou vers notre base temps réel PostgreSQL via notre architecture streaming (webhooks → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run). Étendre la couche d'accès IA : prolonger le MCP Analytics vers BigQuery, construire la couche sémantique qui conditi

jobs.title: Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek
jobs.description: Ben jij een ervaren Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek die impact wil maken in uitdagende Life Sciences-projecten? Ontwerp geavanceerde, duurzame installaties voor high-tech laboratoria, waar jouw expertise écht het verschil maakt. Bij Deerns krijg je de ruimte om complexe projecten te leiden en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van wetenschap en gezondheidszorg.   De uitdaging   Als Senior Engineer Elektrotechniek binnen de Life Sciences speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerp van complexe en technisch productiefaciliteiten, zoals laboratoria. Jij vertaalt klantwensen naar betrouwbare, duurzame en toekomstbestendige elektrotechnische installaties, van energievoorziening tot communicatie- en beveiligingssystemen. Vanaf de conceptfase denk je mee over technische oplossingen die voldoen aan de strengste normen. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines in multidisciplinaire projectteams en bewaakt de kwaliteit en samenhang binnen het ontwerp. Dankzij jouw ervaring stuur je waar nodig bij en ondersteun je collega’s in hun ontwikkeling. In de rol van Senior Engineer neem je bovendien de volledige ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid op je en fungeer je als aanspreekpunt voor zowel klant als ontwerpteam Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: Meedenken in de vroege ontwerp- en conceptfase van projecten, zoals laboratoria of productiefaciliteiten. Uitwerken van elektrotechnische installaties op het gebied van o.a. energievoorziening, verlichting, brandveiligheid, zwakstroom-, beveiligings- en communicatievoorzieningen. Opstellen van kabel- en lichtberekeningen met behulp van gespecialiseerde software. Afstemmen en coördineren van ontwerpwerkzaamheden met de ontwerpleider en andere disciplines. Ondersteunen van de ontwerpleider en projectmanager in de communicatie met klanten en partners.   Hier is waar   We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en het ontwerp van een duurzaam en modern gebouw voor het Nederlands Instituut voor Ruimteonderzoek (SRON), dat meetinstrumenten voor satellieten ontwikkelt. SRON verhuisde naar het Leiden BioScience Park en stelde hoge eisen aan het nieuwe gebouw op het gebied van duurzaamheid, cleanrooms en installatietechniek. Als onderzoeksinstituut gewijd aan het bestuderen van de aardatmosfeer vond SRON het belangrijk om de impact op natuur en milieu te minimaliseren. Daarom koos Deerns in het ontwerp voor warmtepompen voor verwarming en koeling van het gebouw en werden er zonnepanelen op het dak geïnstalleerd. Bovendien kreeg het gebouw het BREEAM-NL certificaat Excellent. We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe, duurzame DSM Lab 6 in Delft, waar Deerns alle technische installaties, elektrische systemen, IT-infrastructuur, beveiliging, mechanische systemen, HVAC (verwarming, ventilatie en airconditioning), transport- en utiliteitssystemen verzorgde. Tijdens de ontwerpfase werden ook de technische en financiële haalbaarheid grondig gecontroleerd. Op basis van de inval van zonlicht in het gebouw, de energieprestatie-eisen en de strenge eisen voor de binnentemperatuur ontwierp Deerns een gevel die voor 25% gesloten is. Dit zorgt voor een natuurlijk koel binnenklimaat, waardoor energie wordt bespaard op verwarmings-, ventilatie- en airconditioningsystemen. Dit ben jij Jij hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor (Hbo/ Wo) in Electrical engineering of een andere technische opleiding. Jij hebt al enige ervaring opgedaan als Engineer Elektrotechniek en bent klaar voor de volgende stap in je carrière. Jij hebt ervaring met werken in projecten en bent een uitstekende teamspeler. Je hebt uitstekende kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (zowel geschreven als gesproken). MS Office, Revit, BIM360 en andere berekeningsprogramma’s hebben geen geheimen voor jou.   Dit bieden wij   Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris.  Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal.  Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagel

jobs.title: Cost Manager (medior/senior)
jobs.description: Ben jij ambitieus, analytisch sterk en klaar voor de volgende stap? Als Cost Manager bij ons advies- en ingenieursbureau werk je aan uitdagende projecten die zichtbaar impact maken. Je bewaakt kosten, adviseert over haalbaarheid en zorgt dat plannen financieel realistisch én toekomstbestendig zijn. Ons bureau is groot genoeg om op topniveau te opereren, maar overzichtelijk genoeg om je echt thuis te voelen. Je krijgt ruimte om te groeien, samen te werken met experts en bij te dragen aan duurzame, innovatieve oplossingen . De uitdaging   Binnen onze projecten groeit de behoefte aan betere budgetcontrole en sturing op kosten. Ook het tijdig signaleren en beheersen van financiële en contractuele risico’s gedurende de hele levenscyclus van een project is cruciaal voor succesvol resultaat. Daarom breiden wij ons Cost Management-team uit. We zoeken een ervaren Cost Manager die het team wil versterken, verder helpen groeien tot een zelfstandige unit en zelf een leidende rol ambieert. Als Cost Manager ben je onderdeel van de unit Special Building Consultancy.   Als Cost Manager speel je een sleutelrol in het beheersen van kosten binnen complexe bouw- en investeringsprojecten. Jij zorgt dat projecten financieel realistisch en beheersbaar blijven van initiatief tot oplevering. Met jouw analytisch inzicht, projectervaring en overtuigingskracht adviseer je over kosten, waarde en haalbaarheid.   Je stuurt het integrale kostenmanagementproces aan en zorgt met betrouwbare en transparante kosteninformatie voor onderbouwde besluitvorming. Daarbij vertaal je financiële analyses en risico-inzichten naar concrete adviezen en bewaak je de toepassing van kostenbeheersingsmethodieken binnen projecten. Kortom een uitdagende functie voor een professional die inhoudelijke expertise combineert met leiderschap en wil bijdragen aan de verdere groei van ons Cost Management-team. Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:  Ontwikkelen en valideren van integrale kostenramingen, kostplannen en -modellen in alle projectfasen; Uitvoeren van haalbaarheidsstudies en benchmarkanalyses; Analyseren van ontwerp-, uitvoerings- en materiaalkeuzes op kostenimpact en risico’s; Beheren en verbeteren van kostenmodellen, kengetallen en benchmarks; Beoordelen van kostenramingen, offertes en nacalculaties van interne en externe partijen; Opstellen van risicoanalyses en uitvoeren van probabilistische kostenanalyses; Monitoren en rapporteren over voortgang, afwijkingen en prognoses t.o.v. budgetten en realisaties; Onderbouwen van investeringsvoorstellen en businesscases met financiële analyses; Beheersen van kostenrisico’s en -kansen gedurende het project; Contractmanagement in de realisatiefase; Bijdragen aan uniforme werkwijzen, benchmarks en kennisdeling binnen het team; (Mede)verantwoordelijk voor interne verbeterprojecten binnen cost management.   Het team   Als onderdeel van ons specialistische Cost Management Team ondersteun je Cost Engineers en projectteams binnen het bureau én werk je rechtstreeks aan opdrachten voor onze klanten. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day. As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands. You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together. You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected. You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law. You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence. You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early. You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster. You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough. Bei uns betreust Du b7-Kunden von der ersten Anforderungsaufnahme bis zum laufenden Betrieb und entscheidest in Deinen Projekten mit, wie Prozesse im System abgebildet werden. Sage X3 gehört ebenfalls zu unserem Portfolio. Wenn Du dort auch schon gearbeitet hast, umso besser. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest Sage-b7-Projekte eigenständig: Konzeption, Customizing, Einführung und spätere Weiterentwicklung beim Kunden. Bei Neukunden bist Du die zentrale Ansprechperson für die b7-Einführung und führst den Kunden durch Anforderungsaufnahme, Testphase und Go-live. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>Our mission</h2> <p>We're making Africa the first cashless continent.</p> <p>In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.</p> <p>We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.</p> <p>Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...</p></div><h2>How you'll help us achieve it</h2> <p>We’re looking for an experienced security engineer who’s independent, excited about getting things done, and ready to hit the ground running. You'll primarily be responsible for our application security, working with our product teams to work on new systems to enhance our security posture. Our customers trust us with their money, and you’ll be at the forefront of making sure we retain that trust!</p> <p>This broadly scoped role will allow you to get your hands on many different types of security projects, from direct application security to helping our infrastructure team think about security for our databases.&nbsp;</p> <p>As we integrate AI-powered agents into our engineering and operations workflows, you'll help define and enforce the guardrails around how we use them safely. This includes securing agentic tooling against prompt injection, excessive permissions, and data exfiltration — and building the policies and technical controls to govern AI usage across the company.</p> <p>Some experience with common industry certifications like ISO-27001 and PCI-DSS would be beneficial, although you won’t be expected to run or oversee audits.</p> <p>Our to-do list changes constantly, but here are some recent projects:</p> <ul> <li>Design our agentic SIEM/SecOps pipelines to evaluate and tune AI-driven triage, alerting, and response automation</li> <li>Secure our MCP integrations against prompt injection, tool misuse, and credential exposure</li> <li>Tune and maintain code security review agents tailored to Wave's codebase, threat model, and regulatory environment</li> <li>Develop internal AI governance standards covering acceptable use, data handling, and audit requirements for LLM-powered tools</li> <li>Centralise application-level login and permissions enforcement including privileged access management</li> <li>&nbsp;Rework our approach to secrets management with ephemeral secrets and tighter access scopes</li> <li>Security review of our public-facing APIs</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key details</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You can work remotely from anywhere (between UTC -5 and +4) with reliable internet access.</li> <li>Wave covers travel once per year to one of our operating countries in Africa, as well as a yearly stipend of $1200 to meet with coworkers.</li> <li>Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App. This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads. What You'll Own Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas. Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads. Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution. Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services. Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions. Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement. Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes. Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing. Programming or scripting skills sufficient to understand, modify, and debug production or test tools; Python or similar is a strong fit. Experience creating and maintaining assembly instructions, SOPs, and controlled production documentation. Ability to work independently across R&D and Production and take ownership of manufacturing readiness. Good spoken and written English. EU/EFTA citizenship or a valid Swiss work permit. Nice to have : Experience with robotics, drones, aerospace, automotive, or other complex hardware products. Experience with both mechanical and electrical assemblies and production test systems. jobs.title: Cleanroom Equipment Technician
jobs.description: Over ons De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is. In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen. De functie Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken. Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving. Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur. Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen. Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen. Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor technische uitdagingen en proactief mogelijkheden identificeren voor systeemverbeteringen en een hogere betrouwbaarheid. Jouw kwalificaties Afgeronde beroepsopleiding in een mechanische, technische of onderhoud gerelateerde richting (bijvoorbeeld automonteur, industrieel monteur, mechatronicatechnicus of vergelijkbaar). Praktische ervaring met mechanische systemen en basiskennis van elektrische, pneumatische, gas- of utiliteitssystemen. Sterke hands-on mentaliteit met het vertrouwen om onbekende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken en nieuwe technologieën te leren. Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, prioriteiten te stellen en volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor toegewezen taken. Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen. Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is. In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. Voor zware lasten worden geschikte hulpmiddelen en ondersteuning van collega’s ingezet. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels, bij voorkeur ook in het Nederlands om te kunnen communiceren met externe partijen, management en operators. Ervaring in de halfgeleiderindustrie is niet vereist. Je ontvangt de nodige training en ondersteuning om de apparatuur te leren kennen en je technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen. We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. Using AI and no-code tools, you'll build pages, tools and campaigns yourself instead of relying on agencies and six-figure budgets. You'll report to the Head of Marketing, who sets direction and priorities. What you'll be doing: Ship growth experiments, fast: Take ideas from our growth backlog and get them live: landing pages, tools, ads and content. Use no-code, AI and vibe coding tools to ship without waiting on engineering. Run creative campaigns: Help launch scrappy, unconventional campaigns across markets, from competitive campaigns to guerrilla and partner media, with the support of our Marketing team. Measure everything: Keep the experiment log up to date: hypothesis, cost, result and next step. Set up tracking and UTMs properly so we know what actually drove each demo. jobs.description: People Business Partner & Total Rewards Most People roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, and to own one of them outright: how Eye rewards and recognises its people. You’ll do that while partnering the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn’t it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading. The role This role has two halves, and you’ll split your time roughly evenly between them. The first half is Total Rewards. You’ll own compensation and benefits at Eye, including salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling, benefits and our equity program. There’s no finished framework waiting for you. You’ll shape it, make it hold up as we grow, and get us ready for EU pay transparency. You don’t need to be a reward specialist yet. You’ll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & onboarding, and project management. It’s the most varied population in the company: working students running shift rosters next to deeply specialized senior engineers, and managers at very different stages of their leadership journey. You’ll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it. What you’ll do Own Total Rewards end to end: run the annual salary review, keep our benchmarks honest, and build levelling and salary bands that make sense to managers and employees alike. Manage our equity program: grants, refreshers, and making sure people understand what their equity means. Prepare Eye for pay transparency: work with Legal and Finance so we’re ready for the EU directive, not scrambling to catch up. Be the trusted partner for leaders in security operations and customer support: coaching, challenging and advising at every level of maturity, up to and including the executive team. Be visible. This is an office where face-to-face matters: you’ll be on the floor in The Hague, listening to what’s actually going on, not partnering from a distance. Handle the real side of employee relations: sick leave and reintegration, conduct issues and complex cases, working with external counsel when needed. You’ve seen the challenging cases and you don’t flinch. Work as part of a small, tight People team: everyone picks things up, and so will you. What we’re looking for HRBP experience in a scaling tech environment. You know what good looks like at 200+ people. Hands-on reward experience. Around a year in a reward or C&B role, or several reward projects you led yourself: salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling or benefits. Specialist depth is not required; curiosity to build it is. Comfortable with numbers. You can build a comp analysis in a spreadsheet and explain it to a manager who has never seen one. Strong stakeholder management and the presence to challenge back, including senior leadership, without becoming the policy police. Genuinely comfortable with ambiguity. Our problems don’t come with a manual, and you’d rather solve them creatively than wait for one. Hands-on, working knowledge of Dutch labor law, and you know when to bring in an expert. jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description: Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more. Our team is small relative to our impact, and we believe our user success is our success (not the inverse). A team member summarized: “Roboflow is a company full of giant brains and tiny egos.” We find software has a multiplier effect on all roles (not only product and engineering), so Roboflow employs developers across the company in design, sales, customer support, marketing, and beyond. We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors. What You'll Do As a Research Scientist, you will originate and drive the novel machine learning research directions that shape Roboflow's research agenda. Because of Roboflow’s huge userbase, we have a unique visibility into how people are using computer vision in the real world, including in what circumstances existing methods are unable to solve user problems. Our Research Team’s mission is to introduce novel methods that generalize as well as possible across our userbase. jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. Deepgram is looking for a Data Scientist to sit at the intersection between research and data: people who think deeply about what conversational data is actually composed of, what makes data valuable, and how to best leverage that. Conversational audio presents incredibly rich scientific, engineering, and infrastructure challenges that are orders of magnitude harder than working with text. Speech carries speakers, accents, dialects, emotion, overlapping talk, code-switching, domain vocabulary, and acoustic conditions that range from a quiet studio to a drive-through — all with rich context that moves the conversation. In this role you'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and data teams to answer those questions rigorously and at scale. You'll care deeply about what makes conversational data difficult, you'll characterize it, and you'll shape the strategies that turn it into model gains. This role rewards conviction, creativity in approach, and a real appetite for overturning your own assumptions when the data says otherwise. Knowing what a trial start actually counts, why tracked revenue and realized revenue are different, how store refunds land in our data, and which model answers a question correctly the first time. That knowledge is what turns a half-formed Slack question into a number someone can act on within the hour. Translate in both directions: business context into robust analysis, data reality into language a non-technical stakeholder can act on. jobs.description: About the Role Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones . Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides. This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content. Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment . Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input. Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides. Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts. Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story. We are not a factory. We are not a revolving door. We are a close-knit, values-driven team that operates with intention — every client gets one point of contact, consistent communication, and work they can count on every single month. We exist to be a collaborative partner to businesses and individuals, providing accurate, reliable insights that allow them to make informed decisions with confidence and grow. The person who thrives here is caring: caring about the work itself, about what it means for the client, for their peers, and for the company as a whole. That caring is what drives someone to get the details right, ask the question instead of guessing, and take pride in a quality product. It also takes someone intrinsically motivated. We won't be standing over your shoulder — we trust you to hold yourself accountable and stay on track. Strong Roots is the most mission-minded place many of our team members have ever worked. We care about our people first, and that shows up in the quality of our work, the strength of our client relationships, and the culture we've built together. jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description: About Lemon.io Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost. Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is. Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill. Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code. Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy. Who You Are: Product-minded, business-first Obsessed with simplicity First principles thinker Fast. Bias toward action Experience: You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company. You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling. You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team. Why Lemon.io : Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals. A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open. Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship. A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers. A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

jobs.title: Consultant - Child Rights
jobs.description: ChildFund Australia is a member of the ChildFund Alliance – a global network of 10 organisations which assists almost 36 million children and their families in 66 countries. ChildFund Australia directly manages and implements programs with a range of local partners in Cambodia, Myanmar, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste, Vietnam, and other Pacific nations, and manages projects delivered by partner organisations throughout Asia, Africa, and the Americas. Purpose ChildFund seeks to strengthen its existing participation approach so that stakeholders can engage with, validate, challenge, and enrich the findings of Child Rights Situation Analyses, helping to identify priority issues, emerging trends, evidence gaps, and opportunities for action. The resulting insights will inform organisational strategy, country planning, program portfolios, advocacy priorities, and investment decisions, ensuring that these are grounded not only in published evidence but also in the perspectives and experiences of children and communities themselves. This assignment will develop practical guidelines, tools, and supporting resources that enable this process to be undertaken consistently across country contexts. The approach should be low burden, repeatable, and designed to leverage existing community engagement structures wherever possible, recognising the capacity constraints facing Country Offices and partners. It should also promote accountability by establishing clear mechanisms for reporting back on how participant feedback influenced findings, priorities, and subsequent decisions. The consultant will also provide technical advice on the role of Youth Voice in ChildFund’s strategy development and broader strategic decision-making, including its evolving purpose, Terms of Reference, engagement processes and feedback mechanisms. The consultancy period is 20 days spread across 3 months. Interested consultants should submit an expression of interest including: a technical proposal (max. 3 pages) outlining understanding of the assignment, proposed search strategy and sources, and workplan; a financial proposal/fee schedule in USD; a curriculum vitae including at least two references from similar assignments; and a sample of previous, similar written work. ChildFund Australia believes in a global community where children are safe and can reach their full potential. We take extensive steps to safeguard children in any work done by our people, i.e., our staff, volunteers and interns, supporters, partners, board members, ambassadors and suppliers. We strive to keep children safe through child safe practices, and rigorously ensure we prevent, oppose, and combat all exploitation and abuse of children and vulnerable people. As part of this commitment, all people working with us will undergo relevant background checks before joining ChildFund Australia . At ChildFund Australia , all staff must remain alert and responsive to any child safeguarding or sexual exploitation, abuse, or harassment (SEAH) risks. Staff will acquire the knowledge and skills needed to understand our Child Safeguarding and PSEAH policies & procedures, promote strong safeguarding practices, and conduct themselves consistent with these policies. In line with our values, diversity of people and ideas is critical to our work and our success at ChildFund Australia . We strive for a team culture that is welcoming, inclusive, and supportive. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care. You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors. Job highlights The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen. In this role, you will: Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed Conduct virtual visits as needed Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.) A Note on Our Work Environment: As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants. Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health “Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home.
